newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Holzmann says CEO report speculative.
newsitem.headline: German Holzmann says CEO report speculative.

text.p: German construction group Philipp Holzmann AG denied on Friday a newspaper report that its chief executive Lothar Mayer faced possible dismissal over losses on a property project.

"Holzmann denies the report in today's (mass circulation daily) Bild," Holzmann's supervisory board chairman Hermann Becker said in a statement, adding that it was "factually incorrect and speculative in its conclusions."

Bild newspaper had earlier reported that auditors were due next week to present a report to a meeting of Holzmann's supervisory board into the losses, which sent Holzmann spinning into losses of 443 million marks last year.
But Holzmann said in its statement that the meeting, set for next Thursday, was simply a regular event that had been scheduled months in advance.

It added that it understood that the report, by auditing group KPMG, had concluded that the Holzmann management board had been informed of the risks of the project but had uncovered no new information on the losses.
Shares in Holzmann traded 18 marks lower at 332 marks after the statement, against 330 marks earlier in the day.
